body.intent: Scripts wait on a virtual clock: cmd/rhiza's testscripts run the engine and the api's run polls on a virtual clock, so the builtin workflows' 30 s polls, 2 min backoff and 2 s spawn polls cost no wall time in tests, while production keeps RealClock and its timing unchanged. Evidence: run-ship-ci-fix takes 165 s wall for 18 s CPU; scripts sleep about 90% of the time (~450 s of a cold make test).
body.title: Scripts on a virtual clock
